text:
wayne: heads up — p95 for /chat/dedicated jumped to ~360ms after yesterday's kernel-chooser swap. noticed bigger microbatches being formed for silver-tier routes. :thinking_face:

maria: :eyes: do you have a flamegraph/profile? could be kv miss regression or different kernel latency curve for shorter sequences.

wayne: pasting quick profile dump from the canary node (trimmed):
```
# top hot stacks (samples)
serialize_tokens  32%
attention_kernel_v2  18%
kv_cache_lookup  14%
batch_formation_wait  12%
other 24%
```
kv_miss_rate up ~3.1% vs baseline. average tokens_per_batch for silver rose from 6.2 -> 9.1.

jon: that tokens_per_batch spike aligns with increased p95. could be queue policy granting larger token budgets to improve throughput but hurting p95. what are current token_budget targets?

wayne: current canary config snippet: 
```json
{"route_tiers": {"gold": 16, "silver": 12, "bronze": 8}, "kv_prefetch": 32, "batch_max_delay_ms": 15}
```
we swapped kernel affinity which reduced single-token kernel cost but increased variance at 8-12 token batches. seems like we overshot for silver.

maria: hypothesis: kernel selection increased per-batch setup cost; batching optimizer then favored larger batches to amortize, but that increases tail when KV misses spike. lowering token budget for silver should help p95. also consider reducing kv_prefetch window for silver so we warm more targeted prefixes.

kelsie: proposing a quick heuristic to compute per-route dynamic cap:
```
# pseudo
observed_p95(route) = measure_p95(route)
if observed_p95 > target_p95:
  token_cap = max( min_cap, token_cap * 0.8 )
else if kv_miss_rate > baseline + 1%:
  token_cap = token_cap - 1
else:
  token_cap = min( max_cap, token_cap * 1.05 )
```
start from a conservative map and apply smoothing over 10 minutes.

jon: looks good — canary plan: reduce silver -> 8, kv_prefetch 16, keep batch_max_delay 15. run for 30m, surface p95, kv_miss, mean_tokens_per_batch, and cost delta.

wayne: i'm going to run that canary on 3 servers with traffic slice 2%. will follow metrics in realtime.

deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated: id=c-2026-3481, routes=[/chat/dedicated], slice=2%, nodes=3. monitoring hooks: perf-dashboard, kv-metrics, batcher-metrics.

perf-bot: nightly profile diff: serialize_tokens +9%, kv_cache_lookup +3.1%, batch_formation_wait -2%. note: p50 improved, p95 regressed for silver-tier.

maria: thanks. if canary reduces p95 back under target we can consider automated controller that decays token_cap on p95 excursions. otherwise rollback.

wayne: first 10m look: silver p95 dropped from 360ms -> 210ms, kv_miss unchanged so far, tokens_per_batch -> 6.8. continuing to watch.

jon: capture baseline traces and attach to the canary ticket. include kernel selection logs so we can correlate which kernel path executed for affected batches.

wayne: will attach traces and kernel logs to the ticket c-2026-3481. action items: kelsie -> implement smoothing and limiter, maria -> run longer 1h canary if initial holds, jon -> add dashboard panels. i'll keep watching. :thumbsup:
